name: SSH Tunnel
description_zh: SSH隧道、端口转发和远程访问模式。适用于本地/远程/动态端口转发、跳板主机配置、SSH密钥管理、连接多路复用、scp/rsync文件传输以及SSH连接调试。
description_en: SSH tunneling, port forwarding, and remote access patterns. Use when setting up local/remote/dynamic port forwards, configuring jump hosts, managing SSH keys, multiplexing connections, transferring files with scp/rsync, or debugging SSH connection issues.
